title: What If You Dug a Hole Through the Earth? (And Jumped In)
short_title: What if you jumped into a hole through the Earth? 🌍 #shorts
description:
Imagine digging a tunnel straight through the planet, and jumping in. Crust, mantle, a core as hot as the Sun's surface, a forty-two-minute fall, weightlessness at the center… Here is what physics says, step by step.
